tagline: The world's largest restaurant company by unit count, operating iconic global brands in 155 countries.
hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric reflecting the health of the global franchised network. In an asset-light model where 97% of units are franchised, aggregate system sales (franchised + company-operated) constitute the best indicator of business size and performance.

kpis.name: System Sales
kpis.explanation: Total sales from all restaurants, franchised and company-operated.
kpis.description: Includes sales from franchised and company-operated restaurants. This is the basis for royalties collected by YUM.
kpis.signal: Key metric for franchised companies: shows global business size.

kpis.name: Franchise Units Percentage
kpis.explanation: Percentage of restaurants operated by independent franchisees.
kpis.description: In 2025, 97% of 63,285 restaurants were operated by franchisees or licensees.
kpis.signal: Very asset-light model: YUM focuses on brand and royalties.

kpis.name: Total Restaurant Count
kpis.explanation: Total number of restaurants in the global network.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, YUM operated 63,285 restaurants across its four concepts (KFC, Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, Habit Burger Grill).
kpis.signal: Massive global network operating in 155 countries and territories.

kpis.name: KFC Restaurant Count
kpis.description: KFC is the portfolio cornerstone with 33,897 units operating in 149 countries, 99% franchised.
kpis.signal: KFC represents 54% of total portfolio (33,897 of 63,285 units) and 90% of international units.

kpis.name: Pizza Hut Strategic Review
kpis.explanation: Ongoing evaluation of strategic options for the Pizza Hut brand.
kpis.description: Initiated in 2025, this strategic review aims to determine the optimal approach to maximize Pizza Hut value as a leader in the fragmented pizza market. Results expected in 2026.
kpis.signal: Value creation opportunity for YUM, Pizza Hut, and its franchisees by capitalizing on brand recognition and scale.

kpis.name: Comparable Store Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Percentage change in sales from restaurants open for more than one year.
kpis.description: Estimated percentage change in system sales from all restaurants open for more than one year in the YUM system. Excludes restaurants temporarily closed for remodeling, natural disasters, or other reasons.
kpis.signal: Key indicator reflecting brand strength, operational initiative effectiveness, and local economic trends.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 8.2 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 13.19 billion euros in the latest year

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company integrates cybersecurity risk management into its global risk management processes. The Audit Committee oversees technology and information security risks, and the CISO reports regularly to the Committee and Board.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in various potential litigations involving franchisors, suppliers, employees, customers, governments, and other parties, which could negatively impact results.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: YUM operates in a highly competitive market with other major restaurant chains and quick-service concepts, which could impact its market share and sales.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: YUM is subject to numerous government regulations regarding food safety, environmental protection, employee rights, and franchised operations, which could increase costs.

risks.title: Geopolitical Exposure
risks.score_rationale: YUM operates in 155 countries and territories, exposing it to geopolitical risks including government changes, conflicts, economic sanctions, and political instability.

risks.title: Brand Reputation
risks.score_rationale: The KFC, Taco Bell, and Pizza Hut brands are sensitive to reputation and consumer trust. Food safety incidents, scandals, or quality issues could severely impact sales.

ai_positioning.summary: YUM does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report. No information indicates the use, development, or risks related to AI.
